question: In a certain code, if HOTEL is written as 30, then how will LATE be written as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f87c2f0c1e89d9ace575625f6d69c4de37c2abbaff3ea23d741b65854b12add5.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**Sum of alphabet positional value ÷ 2 = Number code.**

 
• HOTEL is written as 30.
